command:

printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"

command:

if grep -q '^127\.0\.1\.1[[:space:]]' /etc/hosts; then

else

fi
printf '%s\n' 'hostname configuration applied'

set -eu
expected='os-lab.infra.test'
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'runtime_hostname='; hostname
printf 'persistent_hostname='; cat /etc/hostname
printf 'hosts_entry='; awk '$1 == "127.0.1.1" {print; found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/hosts
printf '%s\n' 'resolver_result:'
getent hosts "$expected"
[ "$(hostname)" = "$expected" ]
[ "$(cat /etc/hostname)" = "$expected" ]
getent hosts "$expected" | awk '$1 == "127.0.1.1" {found=1} END {exit !found}'
